message:
{{#is_alert}}
## P1 · Freshness Breach With Confirmed Pipeline Failure — CONFIRMED
**WHAT:** Distinguishes "the data is late because upstream is slow" (wait) from "the data is late because the job died" (act now).
**WHY THIS IS DIFFERENT:** every member condition below is true at the same time, which is what separates a real incident from an isolated symptom:
  - Data Product Freshness Breach
  - Data Pipeline Job Failure
**WHERE:** {{value}} · env `prod`
**SERVICE / SCOPE:** `data-platform` (data)
**BUSINESS IMPACT:** Confirmed impact: every member condition is true simultaneously, which is the evidence threshold this platform requires before paging on a symptom.
**OWNER:** data-engineering · pages the on-call rotation
**DO THIS NEXT:** Treat as a confirmed incident. The member alerts are the evidence trail; the runbook's remediation section applies directly.
**RUNBOOK:** https://github.com/droderiquesit/enterprise-observability/blob/main/platform/runbooks/pipeline-output-stale.md
**AUTOMATED DIAGNOSTICS:** workflow `remediate-rerun-job`.
**SLO / ERROR BUDGET:** `slo-data-freshness`
{{/is_alert}}
{{#is_recovery}}
## Recovered · Freshness Breach With Confirmed Pipeline Failure
At least one member condition cleared, so the confirmed-impact state no longer holds. Individual member monitors may still be alerting — check before closing the incident.
{{/is_recovery}}

message:
